courier-relay/protocol-versioning: Courier Relay protocol versioning (main.py): CURRENT_PROTOCOL="1" and SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS=("1",). An omitted "protocol" in a request selects CURRENT_PROTOCOL; an explicit supported version selects that version and stays supported after a newer current version is introduced. Commands count (original single-account use) and summary (cross-account batch, issue trial-dvi) share one body, receipt_counts(), which returns exactly {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count} and dispatches on version via accepted_receipts(protocol, receipts); unsupported versions return {"error":"unsupported_protocol"}. When adding protocol N: add a per-version rule function (protocol 1 is accepted_receipts_v1, contract in vendor/protocol-1.md: identity=(account_id, delivery_id) so the same delivery_id under different accounts is a separate delivery and a batch may mix any number of accounts; accept earliest occurred_at UTC instant, ties -> smallest record_id by code point, accepted keep original fields/order), add its branch in accepted_receipts() so both count and summary pick it up, update CURRENT_PROTOCOL only when N becomes current. Timestamps parsed via parse_instant() (RFC3339, Z or numeric offset, compared as UTC). Public suites name protocols explicitly; run python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/<file>.json. Source: issues trial-vbm and trial-dvi, vendor/protocol-1.md.
